Mythic earth faerie with goat legs and an alluring, green- hued, womanly torso, arms, and head. Mistress of fauns and satyrs.

AC 16 (leather), HP 59, ATK 3 leaf whip (near) +8 (3d6) or revel, MV near (burrow, climb), S +4, D +5, C +5, I +4, W +4, Ch +5, AL N, LV 12

Impervious. While in contact with dirt or earth, only damaged by magical sources.

Regenerate. While in contact with dirt or earth, regains 2d6 HP on her turn.

Revel. Glaistig can enchant mortals within near who hear her sing or play music, CHA 15+ or forced to dance for 1d20 hours, 1 CON damage for every hour after the first, helpless.
